subject: Intro: Redwood x Nimbus Health — coordinate AWS joint opportunity

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sonia Vyas <sonia.vyas@amazon.com>, Julia Kaplan <julia.kaplan@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Subject: Intro: Redwood x Nimbus Health — coordinate AWS joint opportunity

Hi Sonia and Julia,

Thanks for taking this — quick intro: Redwood Inference provides a low-latency inference platform that Nimbus is evaluating for patient-facing summarization workflows. We’d love to engage AWS on a joint account approach (co-sell) so Nimbus can take advantage of credits, solution architecture, and procurement support.

Sonia — would you be able to route this to the appropriate AWS co-sell team and SA? Our goal is a short alignment call next week to:
- Surface the core technical fit (latency, VPC/private deployment)
- Align sales motions and potential incentives/credits
- Agree on owners for a mutual action plan (MAP)

Julia — attaching a brief draft MAP and a list of initial success metrics (nimbus-joint-plan-v1.pdf). Can you confirm the internal stakeholders on your side (procurement, security)?

Proposed times: Tue 4/20 10–11am PT, Wed 4/21 9–10am PT. If those don't work we'll adapt.

Thanks — happy to drive the agenda and follow up items.

—
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0122

Attachments: nimbus-joint-plan-v1.pdf

Hi Ben & Julia,

Thanks for the intro. Happy to help coordinate. I’ve looped in our Partner Solutions Architect (CC) and Partner Engagement team. Quick notes:
- PA will want a short tech review ahead of any joint customer session — 30 minutes should suffice.
- Partner Engagement can surface any co-sell credits / incentives once we have a clear opportunity definition.
- Procurement introductions are best included on the initial call if possible.

I can do Tue 4/20 at 10:30am PT or Wed 4/21 at 9am PT. If those are tight, propose Thu 4/22 morning.

Attachment: aws-intro-notes.txt (high level co-sell checklist).

Looking forward to it.

Best,

We should also populate the MAP (attached) with owners and target dates. I'll book the call for Tue 4/20 10:30am PT (to match Sonia's availability) unless anyone flags conflicts — if we need Wed morning I can move it.
